name: Lanthanum tritelluride
equilibrium_context: Unidirectional incommensurate charge density wave along the c axis with a transition temperature above room temperature; small in-plane anisotropy between a and c
summary: Model case for light-induced CREATION of order rather than melting.

driven_states.emergent_property: Creation of a new charge density wave along the a axis which does not exist in equilibrium, accompanied by a weakening of the c-axis CDW. A transient non-thermal phase with no equilibrium counterpart.
driven_states.source: Kogar, Zong et al., Nature Physics 16, 159 (2020), doi:10.1038/s41567-019-0705-3
driven_states.caveat: The evidence is purely diffractive, via superlattice reflections; the associated lattice distortion amplitude and the electronic gap structure of the a-axis CDW state have not been determined independently. Whether this is long-range order or correlated fluctuations of finite correlation length is not conclusively settled.
driven_states.measured_quantity: ultrafast electron diffraction, superlattice reflections along a*

driven_states.emergent_property: Transient CDW state with a high density of topological defects: the amplitude recovers within about one picosecond, the phase coherence only considerably later, limited by defect annihilation. In the intervening window the long-range order is suppressed even though the amplitude has already returned.
driven_states.source: Zong, Kogar et al., Nature Physics 15, 27 (2019), doi:10.1038/s41567-018-0311-9
driven_states.caveat: The evidence for the defects is indirect, via time-scale separation and scaling behavior; there is no direct imaging of individual defects. Strictly speaking not a hidden state in the sense of a new order, but a defect-dominated non-equilibrium state of the same order; included as an intermediate step on the way to hidden phases.

threshold.quantity: critical fluence for defect creation, Kibble-Zurek-like

driven_states.measured_quantity: ultrafast electron diffraction, amplitude and correlation length separated

sources: Kogar, Zong et al., Nature Physics 16, 159 (2020), doi:10.1038/s41567-019-0705-3
Zong, Kogar et al., Nature Physics 15, 27 (2019), doi:10.1038/s41567-018-0311-9
gaps: Fluence values estimated from the description, not verified against the full text.
